intended_object: A helper that names the scalar action r • m of sections of the pointwise left Kan extension (the presheaf inverse image f⁻¹R) on sections of f⁻¹M over an open U, with the module instance `pointwiseModule f R M U` fixed explicitly. Inferred from the docstring and from how the file uses it (`pointwiseSmul_eq` and the lemmas after it).
explanation: The body is just `r • m` computed with one module instance chosen by `letI`. The docstring says its purpose is to "explicitly select" that instance. It is an elaboration device for controlling which instance is used in later rewriting lemmas such as `pointwiseSmul_eq`. It is not a separate mathematical construction: the mathematical content sits in `pointwiseModule`, the module structure on sections of the inverse image presheaf. So it has no counterpart in the literature to compare it with.
